cohort: The study included 177,898 children with linked birth and Australian Early Development Census (AEDC) data, and 115,231 with linked birth and National Assessment Program - Literacy and Numeracy (NAPLAN) data, born in Victoria, Australia, between 2009 and 2021.
finding: Diabetes in pregnancy was not associated with overall developmental vulnerability or a clinically meaningful difference in educational outcomes in offspring during primary school.
